cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the room ready for your dad to arrive from tomorrow. Put his chair by the machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says he can't arrive. I only wanted five minutes with him.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His voice came through. Write down what you want to ask; I'll move the chair closer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered the part that says 'no body signal.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll check the receiver. When his voice comes back, ask if he can see the chair.
